title: Protocol for controlled modeling of human epiblast and amnion development using stem cells
protocol: Maintain hPSCs in mTeSR™1 on 1% Geltrex-coated 6-well tissue culture plates in a cell incubator (37°C, 5% CO₂).
Mix the curing agent and elastomer of PDMS at a 1:10 ratio.
Degas the mixture in a desiccator for 40 mins.
Cast PDMS mixture onto the silicon mold with designed features.
Bake at 110 °C for 40 mins.
Store PDMS layers in a clean zipper bag.
Punch medium loading wells (8mm in diameter) using Harris Uni-Core punch tools.
Punch gel loading ports (1.2mm in diameter) using Harris Uni-Core punch tools.
Cut off individual devices.
Clean the PDMS layers with Scotch tapes to remove particles and debris.
Wash coverslips with ethanol in a sonicator for 60 mins.
Bake coverslips at 110 °C for 20 mins.
Treat the PDMS layers and coverslips with oxygen plasma for 30 secs.
Bond together the treated PDMS layers and coverslips.
Apply pressure for 20 secs when bonding.
Bake bonded devices at 80°C overnight.
Expose the devices to UV light for 30 mins in a cell culture hood.
Prepare a humid chamber by putting a 35 mm Petri dish filled with sterile DI water in a 150 mm Petri dish.
Dilute Geltrex with cold mTeSR™1 to achieve a final concentration of ~8 mg/ml.
Inject diluted Geltrex into a gel loading port to fill the gel channel.
Allow the Geltrex to cure for 10 mins in the humid chamber in a cell incubator.
Check the pocket size every 1-2 mins after 5 mins incubation until desired size is reached (100-120 µm in diameter).
Fill the side channels with mTeSR™1 medium by gently applying vacuum with a rubber dropper bulb.
Incubate the devices filled with mTeSR™1 in a cell incubator for 18-24 hours to stabilize the Geltrex and remove trapped bubbles.
Dissociate human pluripotent stem cells into single cells by incubating with Accutase at 37°C for 10 minutes.
Resuspend the cells in mTeSR™1 containing 10 µM Y27632, achieving a concentration of 8 × 10^6 cells/mL.
Keep the cell suspension on ice.
Empty all the wells of the devices with a vacuum aspirator.
Introduce 10µL hPSC suspension into the cell loading channel.
Allow the hPSC suspension to sediment into the gel pockets by tilting the device by 90° for 10 minutes.
Gently pipette the 10µL hPSC suspension in the well after 5 minutes to stir up the cells.
Fill the devices with mTeSR™1 containing 10 µM Y27632, using 200 µL per well for the cell seeding channel and 160 µL per well for the induction channel.
Supplement BMP4 at 50 ng/mL into BM in the induction channel from t = 0 h onwards.
To generate anteriorized embryonic-like sacs, supplement NOGGIN at 50 ng/mL and IWP2 at 5 µM in DMSO into BM in the cell loading channel from t = 0 h onwards.
Supplement BMP4 at 50 ng/mL into BM in the cell loading channel from t = 0 h onwards to examine posteriorized mesoderm-like cells development.
To examine anteriorized mesoderm-like cells development, add ACTIVIN A at 50 ng/mL into BM in the induction channel.
